contracts.name: ZZZAccessController
contracts.purpose: Direct governance-wallet authorization, fixed module binding/sealing, independent keeper/guardian roles and canonical lifecycle. No timelock, role scheduler or generic transaction executor.

functions.name: constructor
functions.purpose: Select governance, keeper and guardian; deploy fixed helper factories. Deployer holds temporary bootstrap only until seal. Emits the initial KeeperChanged and GuardianChanged grants.
functions.access: Deployment only; three static nonzero address arguments. A governance wallet cannot be the controller itself.

inputs.name: initialGovernance
inputs.label: initialGovernance
inputs.explanation: Reviewed governance wallet, typically a multisig; after sealing it calls configuration targets directly. Its own signatures/nonce authorize transactions.

inputs.name: initialKeeper
inputs.label: initialKeeper
inputs.explanation: Nonzero initial bounded-maintenance operator; role changes separately from governance.

inputs.name: initialGuardian
inputs.label: initialGuardian
inputs.explanation: Nonzero initial pause-only guardian; governance handover does not automatically rotate this role.

functions.name: GOVERNANCE_VERSION
functions.purpose: Read direct-governance profile2; older scheduling controllers have a different ABI and must not be reinterpreted.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: 2 identifies direct governance; this is not an upgrade of historical controllers.

functions.name: acceptGovernance
functions.purpose: The exact proposed wallet accepts authority atomically and clears the proposal. No delay or controller-held transaction funds. Old governance loses authority.
functions.access: Pending nonzero governance wallet only, operating canonical state and no preparation.

functions.name: activationAssetsFactory
functions.purpose: Return the immutable noncustodial ActivationAssets factory created by this controller.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Fixed factory address. Its access() must equal this controller, and assetsOf(Registry) must equal the Registry's bound ActivationAssets child.

functions.name: bind
functions.purpose: Bind one of the16 supported core module slots exactly once before seal, verifying deployed code and matching controller. Unknown/retired module identities reject.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.explanation: One of the16 supported current core Ids; arbitrary or removed bridge IDs reject.

inputs.name: implementation
inputs.label: implementation
inputs.explanation: Deployed compatible module with code, access() bound to this controller, and an unused module slot.

functions.name: bindProtocolPolicy
functions.purpose: Bind the separately deployed fixed noncustodial ProtocolPolicy before deploying its consumers.
functions.access: Current bootstrap only,before seal; one-time binding. Implementation must have code,matching access() and PROTOCOL_POLICY_VERSION1.

inputs.name: implementation
inputs.label: implementation
inputs.explanation: Reviewed ProtocolPolicy1 implementation address; cannot be zero or rebound.

functions.notes: Sealing separately validates its current recipient and module nonaliasing. This binds code,not a custody recipient or arbitrary executor.

functions.name: bootstrap
functions.purpose: Read the temporary deployment/bootstrap authority; zero after seal.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Temporary deployment authority; address zero after seal permanently ends bootstrap configuration.

functions.name: canConfigure
functions.purpose: Check whether an address may currently call governed configuration.

inputs.name: account
inputs.label: account
inputs.explanation: account is the immediate caller being checked.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: False during preparation; bootstrap before sealing, or the current governance wallet after sealing in canonical state0. No controller self-call bypass.

functions.name: cancelPreparation
functions.purpose: Cancel the exact active preparation notice while the source is still operating. Does not rewind a frozen/retired handoff or move custody. Exact noticeHash prevents cancelling a later announcement.
functions.access: Current governance directly while the exact preparation is active and canonical state is operating.

inputs.name: noticeHash
inputs.label: noticeHash
inputs.explanation: noticeHash must equal preparationHash().

functions.name: canonicalHandoff
functions.purpose: Read the fixed whole-collection handoff coordinator.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: The coordinator currently stored under the fixed CANONICAL module ID; no arbitrary execution target.

functions.name: canonicalSettling
functions.purpose: Read whether the coordinator has enabled its bounded settlement phase.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: True only while the coordinator has enabled captured source-cutoff settlement in frozen state1.

functions.name: canonicalState
functions.purpose: Read canonical lifecycle: 0 operating, 1 frozen, 2 importing, 3 retired, 4 cancelled.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Lifecycle code:0 operating,1 frozen source,2 inert importer,3 retired source,4 cancelled importer.

functions.name: canonicalTransition
functions.purpose: Allow only the bound coordinator to change canonical lifecycle; terminal retired/cancelled states and impossible higher states cannot reopen.
functions.access: Bound canonicalHandoff only; internal protocol endpoint, not an operator shortcut.

inputs.name: state
inputs.label: state
inputs.explanation: Canonical lifecycle code 0 operating / 1 frozen / 2 importing / 3 retired / 4 cancelled.

inputs.name: settling
inputs.label: settling
inputs.explanation: True permits the coordinator’s bounded settlement phase only when state=1; false disables settlement mode.

inputs.name: clearPreparation
inputs.label: clearPreparation
inputs.explanation: True clears preparationActive during this authenticated transition; false preserves the current flag.

functions.name: governance
functions.purpose: Read the current governance wallet, which configures allowed policy and may initiate collective principal return to holders; cannot replace sealed module identities.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Current human-controlled governance wallet; its own authorization rules are external to this contract.

functions.name: guardians
functions.purpose: Read whether an address is recorded as an enabled guardian. A stored role flag is not the complete canonical/lifecycle authorization check.

inputs.label: input0
inputs.explanation: Public account address whose stored role flag is inspected.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Recorded pause-only grant; it does not authorize unpause, governance configuration or holder claims.

functions.name: isSealed
functions.purpose: Read whether bootstrap binding is permanently closed.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Whether required module setup has been sealed and bootstrap cleared; not production qualification.

functions.name: keeperAuthorized
functions.purpose: Check effective keeper authorization for a caller.

inputs.name: caller
inputs.label: caller
inputs.explanation: Immediate caller address whose effective keeper authorization is checked against current seal/canonical state.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Requires sealed, operating canonical state and an enabled keeper; pause/preparation are checked separately by operation modifiers.

functions.name: keepers
functions.purpose: Read whether an address is recorded as an enabled keeper. A stored role flag is not the complete canonical/lifecycle authorization check.

inputs.label: input0
inputs.explanation: Public account address whose stored role flag is inspected.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Recorded keeper grant only; keeperAuthorized additionally checks sealing and canonical state.

functions.name: lpExitStarted
functions.purpose: Read the irreversible collective LP-retirement flag, separate from ordinary pause and canonical state.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: True once the fixed Vault commits governance-triggered holder exit; cannot be cleared or bypassed by unpausing.

functions.name: module
functions.purpose: Look up the fixed module registered under an Ids hash.

inputs.label: input0
inputs.explanation: Exact Ids module hash, not a role hash or arbitrary address.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Bound contract address; zero means unbound.

functions.name: moduleAuthorized
functions.purpose: Check effective identity authorization for a fixed module.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.explanation: Fixed protocol module identity hash.

inputs.name: caller
inputs.label: caller
inputs.explanation: Immediate caller address that must equal the currently bound module for id.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Requires sealed normal canonical state; does not replace other function guards.

functions.name: paused
functions.purpose: Read the ordinary global pause flag; separate from canonical/preparation locks.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Global ordinary-operation pause flag; claims/transfers and explicit allowed recovery retain separate guards.

functions.name: pendingGovernance
functions.purpose: Read the proposed next governance wallet, or zero if no proposal. It has no governance authority until accepting.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Proposed next wallet awaiting its own acceptance; zero means no pending proposal/cancellation.

functions.name: preparationActive
functions.purpose: Read whether the collection-replacement preparation window is active.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Whether the cancellable pre-handoff preparation guard is active; not proof of source freeze or fund delivery.

functions.name: preparationHash
functions.purpose: Read the exact active/latest preparation-notice commitment.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Hash of the exact preparation notice, source controller/modules, chain and nonce; retained historical value after cancellation.

functions.name: preparationNonce
functions.purpose: Read the monotonically increasing preparation-notice identity.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Monotonically incremented count/identity component of started preparation notices.

functions.name: preparationNotice
functions.purpose: Read destination chain/controller and public deployment/review commitments.

outputs.name: destinationChain
outputs.label: destinationChain
outputs.explanation: Announced destination chain ID; supported preparation requires this same canonical chain.

outputs.name: successorController
outputs.label: successorController
outputs.explanation: Announced successor AccessController; authenticated local importer readiness is checked separately.

outputs.name: deploymentCommitment
outputs.label: deploymentCommitment
outputs.explanation: Reviewed destination deployment commitment; not independent proof the replacement code is safe.

outputs.name: reviewHash
outputs.label: reviewHash
outputs.explanation: Nonzero governance review commitment for this preparation notice; not a security certificate.

functions.name: preparationReadyDestination
functions.purpose: Read whether startPreparation validated a sealed same-chain importer at announcement.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Whether notice admission validated an already sealed inert local importer bound to this source; not completion of import/funding.

functions.name: preparationStartedAt
functions.purpose: Read the notice announcement Unix timestamp.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Unix timestamp in seconds of the latest started notice; there is no enforced preparation waiting period.

functions.name: proposeGovernance
functions.purpose: Propose a governance-wallet replacement without a delay; zero cancels a proposal. Existing authority remains until the exact candidate accepts. Keeper/guardian/mint-recipient roles do not change.
functions.access: Current governance only, canonical operating state and no preparation. Controller-self/current-wallet candidates reject.

inputs.name: candidate
inputs.label: candidate
inputs.explanation: Proposed wallet; address zero cancels. Review its keys/signers/threshold independently before accepting.

functions.name: protocolPolicy
functions.purpose: Read the fixed separately bound operating-policy helper.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: ProtocolPolicy1 address; zero before one-time bootstrap binding.

functions.name: royaltyFactory
functions.purpose: Read the immutable factory for NFT-bound royalty ledgers.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Immutable controller-created factory used to construct NFT-bound separate royalty ledgers.

functions.name: seal
functions.purpose: Irreversibly close bootstrap after complete unique module/companion, randomness and matching nonzero fixed contribution/exit ZZZ bindings are validated.
functions.notes: Requires the one-time fixed ProtocolPolicy1 binding with matching controller,distinct required module identities and valid current mint recipient; initializes no new economic work. Source6 canonical admission remains separate from identical-width old records.

functions.name: setGuardian
functions.purpose: Grant or revoke guardian pause authority and emit GuardianChanged for the resulting state. This does not grant governance, unpause, keeper or custody-exit authority.
functions.access: Before sealing: only the current bootstrap address, not a distinct governance wallet. After sealing: only current governance with canonicalState=0 and no preparation. No waiting period; ordinary pause alone does not block configuration.

inputs.name: who
inputs.label: who
inputs.explanation: Nonzero account to add to or remove from this protocol role.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.label: enabled
inputs.explanation: True enables the recorded role; false revokes it. Existing transactions and separate lifecycle checks are not bypassed.

functions.name: setKeeper
functions.purpose: Grant or revoke bounded keeper maintenance authority and emit KeeperChanged. Initial grants are also emitted by the constructor; no management or custody-exit authority is added.
functions.access: Before sealing: only the current bootstrap address, not a distinct governance wallet. After sealing: only current governance with canonicalState=0 and no preparation. No waiting period; ordinary pause alone does not block configuration.

inputs.name: who
inputs.label: who
inputs.explanation: Nonzero account to add to or remove from this protocol role.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.label: enabled
inputs.explanation: True enables the recorded role; false revokes it. Existing transactions and separate lifecycle checks are not bypassed.

functions.name: setPaused
functions.purpose: Set or clear ordinary global pause. Pause does not retire the collection, freeze every claim/settlement path or move assets. Clearing pause does not bypass preparation/canonical locks.
functions.access: Current governance, bootstrap before seal, or an enabled guardian for state=true only. Canonical lifecycle guards remain independent.

inputs.name: state
inputs.label: state
inputs.explanation: state=true pauses; state=false resumes ordinary live work when other guards permit.

functions.name: startLPExit
functions.purpose: Commit irreversible collective LP retirement through the Vault nonreentrant barrier; does not itself close LP or pay holders.
functions.access: Only the fixed Vault, sealed and paused, in canonical operating state with no preparation active.
functions.notes: Invoked only by the fixed Migration begin path. Once set, principal operations and canonical replacement cannot reopen the LP; reward claims, transfers and royalties remain separate.

functions.name: startPreparation
functions.purpose: Announce a cancellable same-chain replacement/draining window; no custody or rights leave. A deployed successor must already be sealed/importing and committed to this source.
functions.access: Current governance directly, sealed canonical operating state.

inputs.name: notice
inputs.label: notice
inputs.explanation: Explicit current chain ID, successor controller distinct from source, deployment commitment and nonzero review hash. A notice alone never authorizes a freeze/import.

functions.notes: Starts a cancellable same-chain canonical preparation window only before collective LP exit. A terminal lpExitStarted flag permanently rejects replacement preparation.

contracts.name: ZZZActivationAssets
contracts.purpose: Fixed ETH/ZZZ-only contribution-source policy. ZZZ identity is selected once before sealing; same-token admission/pins remain governed. Pair accounting and NFT marketplace royalty currencies are separate.

functions.name: constructor
functions.purpose: Bind the immutable controller and Registry through the controller's fixed factory, without an arbitrary direct-construction bypass.
functions.access: Only controller.activationAssetsFactory(); that factory's access() must equal controller. The fixed factory derives poolRegistry from its own create() caller.

inputs.name: controller
inputs.label: controller
inputs.explanation: Existing AccessController contract; must be the factory's immutable controller.

inputs.name: poolRegistry
inputs.label: poolRegistry
inputs.explanation: Nonzero Registry/caller address bound to this unique child by the factory.

functions.name: NATIVE_ASSET_CODE_HASH
functions.purpose: Read the explicit native-ETH identity hash; it is not deployed code.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Explicit native-ETH identity marker keccak256(ZZZ_NATIVE_ETH_V1); native ETH has no deployed bytecode.

functions.name: SOURCE_POLICY_VERSION
functions.purpose: Return the explicit fixed ETH/ZZZ input-policy profile version.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Version1: native ETH plus the one pre-seal ZZZ identity, with no third user contribution currency.

functions.name: access
functions.purpose: Read the immutable controller binding.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Controller address; not a treasury or royalty payout address.

functions.name: activePolicy
functions.purpose: Read the current source-admission policy ID for an asset.

inputs.label: input0
inputs.explanation: Actual asset address; zero means native ETH.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Current append-only source-policy ID; zero means unset, not a healthy enabled source.

functions.name: admitPoolAsset
functions.purpose: Initially record a target-pair currency without widening contribution inputs. Known policies are returned unchanged; a different accounting currency is recorded contribution-disabled.
functions.access: Only the immutable Registry. Pool admission does not grant a new external input or override a disabled source.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: token
inputs.explanation: Actual target-pair accounting currency; zero is native ETH. Other pair currencies may be priced/accounted while remaining invalid user sources.

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.explanation: Existing policy ID unchanged, or new pool-admission ID enabled only when the currency is ETH or the fixed ZZZ identity.

functions.name: configureZZZ
functions.purpose: Configure the fixed ZZZ ERC20 once before sealing and record its validated source policy. Reconfiguration, even to the same address, is rejected. A new token requires a separately reviewed deployment; collective exit returns actual existing ETH + ZZZ to NFT owners, not an administrator.
functions.access: Only the current bootstrap before sealing; unavailable after sealing. A distinct governance wallet is not the bootstrap. Additional guards: unset fixed ZZZ identity and valid current code/decimals/dual pricing.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: token
inputs.explanation: Nonzero ERC20 contract to serve as this deployment's fixed ZZZ source.

inputs.name: expectedCodeHash
inputs.label: expectedCodeHash
inputs.explanation: Reviewed nonzero runtime hash that must match token.codehash.

inputs.name: reviewHash
inputs.label: reviewHash
inputs.explanation: Nonzero provenance commitment for this explicit token/code/price-policy review; not an independent-audit claim.

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.explanation: Append-only activated policy ID for the enabled fixed ZZZ identity.

functions.name: isContributionAsset
functions.purpose: Check permitted source identity only: native ETH or the configured ZZZ. Does not itself check enablement, runtime, price or precision.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: token
inputs.explanation: Candidate original user-supplied currency; zero means native ETH.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: True for native ETH or the fixed nonzero ZZZ identity, even when that identity's current source policy is disabled. value(nonzero) enforces the additional live policy checks.

functions.name: policies
functions.purpose: Read immutable source policy token, enabled state, code/review pins, decimals and admission provenance.

inputs.label: input0
inputs.explanation: Immutable source-asset admission policy ID, obtained from activePolicy(asset) or policyAt(ordinal).

outputs.name: token
outputs.label: token
outputs.explanation: Actual token identity; zero denotes native ETH for an existing native policy.

outputs.name: enabled
outputs.label: enabled
outputs.explanation: Whether this recorded source policy enables contributions; existence/identity/prices still require validation.

outputs.name: expectedCodeHash
outputs.label: expectedCodeHash
outputs.explanation: Expected token runtime hash, or the explicit native identity marker; not proxy implementation attestation.

outputs.name: reviewHash
outputs.label: reviewHash
outputs.explanation: Recorded governance/admission review commitment; not proof of independent review.

outputs.name: decimals
outputs.label: decimals
outputs.explanation: Admitted raw token precision,0..18; zero is also an unset mapping default and must not imply a valid policy.

outputs.name: poolAdmission
outputs.label: poolAdmission
outputs.explanation: True if this record originated through initial authenticated pool-asset admission, rather than an explicit source-policy review.

functions.name: policyAt
functions.purpose: Read the immutable policy ID at a zero-based history ordinal.

inputs.name: ordinal
inputs.label: ordinal
inputs.explanation: Zero-based immutable source-policy history index; must be less than policyCount().

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Policy ID at the zero-based history index; out-of-bounds access reverts.

functions.name: policyCount
functions.purpose: Read the total immutable source-policy history length.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Number of append-only recorded source policies, including superseded/disabled records.

functions.name: registry
functions.purpose: Read the fixed parent Registry.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Immutable Registry parent authorized to initially admit its accounting pair; no custody recipient.

functions.name: setAsset
functions.purpose: Append and activate same-identity source enablement/runtime policy. Cannot introduce a third input currency or change the fixed ZZZ address. Disabling deliberately avoids failed token and price reads.
functions.access: Before sealing: only the current bootstrap address, not a distinct governance wallet. After sealing: only current governance with canonicalState=0 and no preparation. No waiting period; ordinary pause alone does not block configuration.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: token
inputs.explanation: Native ETH zero or fixed ZZZ when enabling; another historical token may only be disabled, not admitted as a third source.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.label: enabled
inputs.explanation: True validates and enables the permitted source identity; false stops future nonzero contributions without changing existing LP or claims.

inputs.name: expectedCodeHash
inputs.label: expectedCodeHash
inputs.explanation: Current reviewed token runtime hash, or NATIVE_ASSET_CODE_HASH for ETH. Disable paths record the supplied pin without querying a failing dependency.

inputs.name: reviewHash
inputs.label: reviewHash
inputs.explanation: Nonzero commitment documenting this source-policy change.

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.explanation: New immutable policy ID; prior history is preserved.

functions.name: value
functions.purpose: Return conservative USD18 value of actual original input under enabled source/runtime/precision/dual-price checks. Nonzero unsupported input reverts, including the direct-Vault valuation path.
functions.access: Read-only; any caller. Pair admission alone is insufficient. A zero amount returns zero without reading that currency's dependencies.

inputs.name: token
inputs.label: token
inputs.explanation: Original input identity; native ETH zero or the fixed ZZZ contract for a nonzero amount.

inputs.name: amount
inputs.label: amount
inputs.explanation: Raw original input units: wei for ETH or the token's validated decimals for ZZZ.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Conservative lower-bound USD value in18decimals, or zero for zero input; never an assumed stablecoin peg.

functions.name: zzz
functions.purpose: Return the fixed reviewed ZZZ contribution identity. It is not a mutable migration target.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Configured ERC20 ZZZ address, or zero before the one-time bootstrap configuration. A valid production Registry must configure it before sealing.

contracts.name: ZZZActivationAssetsFactory
contracts.purpose: Fixed noncustodial deployment factory that splits Registry initcode and creates one immutable source-policy child for each caller; no policy, custody or execution authority.

functions.name: constructor
functions.purpose: Capture the creating AccessController as the immutable controller for every child.
functions.access: Deployment only; the production AccessController constructor deploys this fixed factory.

functions.name: access
functions.purpose: Return the immutable controller whose source-policy children this factory deploys.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: AccessController address captured as msg.sender when the factory was constructed.

functions.name: assetsOf
functions.purpose: Return the unique already-created ActivationAssets child for a Registry/caller.

inputs.label: input0
inputs.explanation: Registry or other caller address whose create() invocation is being inspected.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Bound child address, or zero if this caller has not created one.

functions.name: create
functions.purpose: Deploy and permanently bind exactly one ActivationAssets child to this caller. Cannot replace a previously created child.
functions.access: Permissionless deployment paid by the caller; production Registry invokes it during construction. This gives no right to configure another Registry or move funds.

outputs.name: child
outputs.label: child
outputs.explanation: New ActivationAssets address with registry=msg.sender and access=this factory's immutable controller.

contracts.name: ZZZActivationEntry
contracts.purpose: Atomically convert reviewed owner input into actual attached LP with exact allowance, price/context and signed-loss checks.

functions.name: constructor
functions.purpose: Create the parent-bound Entry and its fixed typed-v4 executor.
functions.access: Fixed Registry constructor only; no arbitrary child replacement.

inputs.name: controller
inputs.label: controller
inputs.explanation: Same controller as Registry.

inputs.name: poolRegistry
inputs.label: poolRegistry
inputs.explanation: Creating Registry address; must equal msg.sender.

inputs.name: assets
inputs.label: assets
inputs.explanation: The Registry-created ActivationAssets with exact controller/parent bindings.

functions.name: REVIEW_POLICY_VERSION
functions.purpose: Read explicit signed loss plus scoped contribution-policy review interface.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: 2; explicit fresh runtime,never a relabel or upgrade of an old deployment.

functions.name: access
functions.purpose: Read the immutable controller binding.

outputs.label: output0

functions.name: activationAssets
functions.purpose: Read the immutable source-asset admission helper.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Immutable source-admission helper bound to this Entry and Registry.

functions.name: addRoute
functions.purpose: Append and enable an immutable typed-v3 route whose original source is the fixed reviewed ZZZ. Native ETH uses direct/native-v4 paths; no stablecoin or WETH source is admitted by recording a target-pair route.
functions.access: Before sealing: only the current bootstrap address, not a distinct governance wallet. After sealing: only current governance with canonicalState=0 and no preparation. No waiting period; ordinary pause alone does not block configuration. Additional guards: operating canonical lifecycle and no preparation, nonReentrant.

inputs.name: policy
inputs.label: policy
inputs.explanation: RoutePolicy(source,output,router,factory,pool,fee,routerCodeHash,factoryCodeHash,poolCodeHash,sourceCodeHash,outputCodeHash,reviewHash). Fee is millionths; reviewHash nonzero.

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.explanation: Content-derived immutable route ID.

functions.name: addV4Route
functions.purpose: Append and enable a reviewed hookless typed-v4 route for an original ETH/ZZZ source. Target output may be an admitted accounting currency without becoming a third user input.
functions.access: Before sealing: only the current bootstrap address, not a distinct governance wallet. After sealing: only current governance with canonicalState=0 and no preparation. No waiting period; ordinary pause alone does not block configuration. Additional guards: operating canonical lifecycle and no preparation, nonReentrant.

inputs.name: policy
inputs.label: policy
inputs.explanation: Policy(source,output,key(currency0,currency1,fee,tickSpacing,hooks),poolManager,stateView,sourceCodeHash,outputCodeHash,poolManagerCodeHash,stateViewCodeHash,reviewHash).

outputs.name: id
outputs.label: id
outputs.explanation: Domain/chain/parent-bound immutable route ID.

functions.name: executeReviewed
functions.purpose: Atomically fund ETH/fixed-ZZZ activation or growth under captured Entry2 minima,idle policy,signed loss maximum and verified marginal LP.
functions.access: Current NFT owner only, sealed/live/operating and nonReentrant; current source policy, route, dual-price context and exact Vault call must all validate. ERC721 operator approval is not funding authority.

inputs.name: request
inputs.label: request
inputs.explanation: Request tuple: nftId actual canonical NFT ID; poolId exact admitted PoolKey hash; sourceAsset zero for native ETH or approved ERC20; amountIn raw source units/wei; routeId zero only for direct accounting input; minimumOut raw converted output (must be zero for direct route); minimumLiquidity actual positive v4 liquidity units; deadline Unix seconds from now through +600; increase false activation / true growth.

inputs.name: maximumLossBps
inputs.label: maximumLossBps
inputs.explanation: Signed maximum combined conversion/placement/undeployed-value loss in basis points, 0..1000. Captured execution policy may be tighter, never wider; gas excluded.

inputs.name: expectedContributionPolicy
inputs.label: expectedContributionPolicy
inputs.explanation: Exact current ProtocolPolicy.entryFingerprint() bytes32 from the reviewed snapshot; nonzero. Any scoped entry-policy revision/change before or during execution reverts. This is not an arbitrary reviewHash.

functions.native_value: Exact msg.value=amountIn when sourceAsset is zero/native ETH; exact msg.value=0 for ERC20 input. A mismatch reverts before execution. Internal conversion/native settlement is authenticated and exact, not an extra user payment. Network gas is separate.
functions.notes: Gross minimum is rejected before Pricing context writes or token pulls. Original source and pair prices freeze before external input movement; approval cleanup and final policy/owner/balance checks precede success. Multiply-invalid requests can now fail amount validation before a different pricing error.

functions.name: pricingContext
functions.purpose: Confirm the exact live contribution context to the fixed Pricing companion.
functions.access: Current Oracle-created ContributionPricing only; internal view endpoint.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.explanation: Actual NFT ID in the active owner-funded contribution.

inputs.name: pool
inputs.label: pool
inputs.explanation: Exact pool ID in that same active contribution.

inputs.name: packed
inputs.label: packed
inputs.explanation: Two raw uint128 amounts packed as amount0 | (amount1 << 128); currency0/1 follow pool ordering.

inputs.name: gross
inputs.label: gross
inputs.explanation: Frozen original-source contribution value in USD18 (1 USD=10**18), not the current LP mark.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Boolean exact context/owner match; an unauthorized caller reverts.

functions.name: registry
functions.purpose: Read the immutable parent Registry.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Immutable Registry parent; Vault and pair bindings are revalidated through Access.

functions.name: route
functions.purpose: Read an immutable typed-v3 policy; unknown/non-v3 IDs revert.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.explanation: Exact immutable typed conversion route ID. Zero is the direct-input sentinel, not a stored conversion route.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Recorded typed v3 RoutePolicy, in ABI order:source/output ERC20 identities; router/factory/pool; fee in millionths; runtime hashes for router/factory/pool/source/output; nonzero reviewHash. Unknown v3 route IDs revert. Recording does not itself make a current native principal conversion feasible.

functions.name: routeEnabled
functions.purpose: Read whether an existing route is enabled for new conversions.

inputs.name: id
inputs.label: id
inputs.explanation: Exact immutable typed conversion route ID. Zero is the direct-input sentinel, not a stored conversion route.

outputs.label: output0
outputs.explanation: Recorded enabled state for the route kind; dependencies, prices and current source/pair still need execution-time validation.

functions.name: routeExists
functions.purpose: Check whether an immutable conversion route ID exists.
